policy: Candidate filters only. They do not change scores, verdicts, or production weights.

rules.label: Financial strength
rules.hypothesis: A strong balance sheet may give the business enough time to realize its valuation.

rules.label: Financial strength plus durable growth
rules.hypothesis: Strong finances and high point-in-time growth may reduce growth-disappointment failures.

rules.label: Durable growth at a reasonable entry
rules.hypothesis: Growth must be paired with valuation and market confirmation to support a one-year re-rating.

rules.label: Durable growth with forward-EPS confirmation
rules.hypothesis: Expected EPS growth may confirm that reported growth is expected to continue.
